info.title: API.SH: Computrabajo
info.description: The Computrabajo API from API.SH: public Computrabajo data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Computrabajo's employer directory for a country (or a name search): name, link, sector, description, rating, review count, open jobs and location. Pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/computrabajo-companies

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country site (ar, bo, cl, co, cr, do, ec, gt, hn, mx, ni, pa, pe, pr, py, sv, uy, ve).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Company name contains.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An employer on Computrabajo: name, logo, verified badge, rating, followers, the number of open jobs, reviews, salaries and interviews, links to its other tabs, and its open jobs (20 per page). Accepts the employer's standard page or its branded page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/computrabajo-company

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Employer page URL (company_url in search and job results).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page (1-based). Pass next_page back; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One job ad on Computrabajo: title, employer (or the site's text for confidential ads), location, salary with currency and period, contract type, working hours, modality, requirements (education, experience, knowledge), skills, industry, posting date, closing date, full description and apply link. Give `url`, or `q` (plus any search filter) to open the first matching current ad.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/computrabajo-job

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Job URL on any *.computrabajo.com site.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job id (32 characters at the end of the URL), with country.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Computrabajo country site (default co).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (job title or skill).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Region or city as in the site's URLs (e.g. bogota-dc, antioquia, jalisco, lima).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug when searching without q (e.g. informatica-y-telecom; see facets).

parameters.name: schedule
parameters.description: Working hours.

parameters.name: posted
parameters.description: Only ads from the last N days (99 = urgent ads).

parameters.name: salary
parameters.description: Salary range value from the Salario facet (ranges differ by country).

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Contract type value from the Contrato facet (e.g. 5 indefinite term in Colombia).

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: Experience value from the Experiencia facet (4 one year, 5 two years, 6 three to four years).

parameters.name: disability
parameters.description: 1 = only ads open to people with disabilities.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Job ads on Computrabajo (Latin America's largest job board, one site per country: Colombia, Mexico, Argentina, Peru, Chile, Ecuador and 12 more) for keywords, a region or city, or a category, with the site's filters: posting date, salary range, contract type, experience, working hours, disability-friendly and sort. Each result has the title, employer with its rating, location, salary, work modality, posting age and link; confidential ads show the site's generic employer text. `facets` lists every filter value with its count. 20 per page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/computrabajo-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
